verdicts.reason: A keeps the clean left-aligned quote column with good margins, but the quote mark is stranded far above the quote with a dead gap between them, the logo floats in the middle of the attribution row instead of on a clear edge, and the glass sits high and off-centre in its circle. B crams the oversized quote against the top edge in five choppy lines, moves the opening quote mark to the side, halfway down the text block, which looks odd, and centres the logo under left-aligned text so nothing lines up, though the glass sits well inside its circle.
